Have a quick read before you film, keep it open while you go, or check back after. Whatever fits how you work. Open any check to see photos of the right way and the wrong way. 👀

    💬 I'm always here. Message me any time: a shot you're not sure about, an idea you want to run past me, or just a second pair of eyes before you submit. There is genuinely no such thing as a silly question, so please ask me rather than guess. 😊

    We build Bambora with a lot of love, and the work you're doing really matters. Every video you make puts that in front of another parent who needs it, so we want to make this as easy as we possibly can for you. 💙

    That's also why we're careful with the safety checks. If something isn't quite right, I'll just ask you to film that little bit again. It is never a criticism of your video. 🤍
